jobs.title: Chowkidar
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for filling following vacant post under Balochistan share
(6%) at Office of the Wafaqi Mohtasib (OWM), Regional Office, Quetta from citizens of
Pakistan holding domicile or valid residence certificate of Balochistan
Position: Chowkidar
BPS: 01
No. of Vacancies: 01
Place of Posting: Quetta, Balochitan
Age Limit: 18-35 (including 05 Years General Age Relaxation+ 05 Years additional relaxation for candidates from Balochistan)
Qualification: Primary
TERMS AND CONDITIONS/GENERAL INFORMATION
The subject recruitment shall be made on criteria/mechanism defined by the Establishment Division vide their Office Memorandums F.No.2/5/2026-BEFC/001 dated 22.10.2026 and 27.10.2026.
Interested Candidates are required to apply online via National Job Portal (https://njp.gov.pk) within fifteen days of publication of advertisement.
Government Servants must apply through proper channel after obtaining NOC.
Only shortlisted candidates will be called for walk-in-interviews and no TA/DA will be admissible in this regard.
Applicants must bring original documents and domicile/ valid residence certificate at the time of walk-in-interviews alongwith the attested copies of same.
Further age relaxation will be applicable as per prevailing Government Policy/ Rules
